item.title: Shanghai AI Lab Ships Intern Physical World Model W0 for Force-Tactile Robotics
item.description: Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory released Intern physical world model W0 with native force-tactile sensing and duplex collaboration, linking it to Intern InkStone and science model S2 for wet- and dry-lab closed loops such as lipid nanoparticle synthesis.

item.title: Shengshu Technology Releases Motus2 Self-Evolving World Model for Dexterous Manipulation
item.description: Shengshu Technology (GensPI), with Tsinghua-affiliated researchers, unveiled Motus2 — a shared-parameter world-action, action-conditioned world and value model loop for dexterous manipulation, lifting phone-placement success from about 65% to 75% with ~130k hours of egocentric data.

item.title: DeepSeek App Gray-Tests Native AI Voice Chat With Four TTS Voices
item.description: DeepSeek is gray-testing in-app AI voice chat: a speaker control in the top-right corner and four selectable TTS voices — Beike, Bailang, Haixing and Anchao — as a product feature distinct from Flash GA and the Pro-to-Flash API cutover.

item.title: China Mobile Cloud Debuts GPU–Neuromorphic Heterogeneous LLM Inference Stack
item.description: At the 2026 China Computing Power Conference, China Mobile Cloud and partners unveiled a domestic GPU plus neuromorphic mixed-inference system for large models, citing roughly 2× output and energy gains and over 40% lower opex on DeepSeek V4 Flash.
